description: Test manifests for the entry fields conformance_profile, transport and layer (README.md, Manifest entry fields) and for the source-case layout (README.md, Manifest): four valid and nine invalid. Each file is a whole manifest. Validate it against the schema, then apply the field rules of section Checks; paths are not resolved. A valid case passes both. An invalid case fails the schema with exactly the errors in schema_errors (instance_pointer is the RFC 6901 location in the file, keyword the failing JSON Schema keyword; empty when the schema cannot express the rule) and the field rules with exactly the rule ids in rules.

cases.reason: no entry names a conformance profile, a transport or a layer: each runs under full, over https, for every layer
conformance_profile lists full, single-owner or both; a profile entry has scope runner
transport lists https and stdio-ipc; layer only where transport has stdio-ipc; transport entries have scope runner, the mcp entry scope adapter
a source case is the file sources/<source>/<case>.json with the id sources/<source>/<case>, whose case segment may contain a dot; its scope is adapter and it has no expected file and no outcome
conformance_profile names lite, which is not a conformance profile id of spec/v1.0/profiles/registry.json
transport names tcp, which is neither https nor stdio-ipc
layer is network, which is neither transcript nor os
layer is set on an entry whose transport is https only
an entry of kind transport names no layer, so it does not say who executes it
two entries share the id admission/valid; JSON Schema cannot state unique ids
conformance_profile is the string full, not an array
a source case has scope core; every source-case entry has scope adapter
